Key Layout and Structure:
1. Shell & Header:
- Dark navy sidebar (#0F172A) with 'BICE Admin Super Admin' badge, navigation items (Overview: Dashboard, Analytics; Learning Catalog: Courses, Categories, Curriculums, Batches & Cohorts; Students & Teams: Learners, Enterprise Access, Instructors; Financials: Orders & Revenue, Payouts, Coupons; Settings & Configuration: System Settings [ACTIVE/HIGHLIGHTED with indigo-600 background], Role Permissions, Audit Logs).
- Top navigation bar: Breadcrumbs 'Admin > System Settings > General Configuration', Search bar with keyboard shortcut cmd+K, Date filter / environment indicator ('Production API 99.9% / Live Sync'), Notifications badge (3 unread), Admin profile dropdown ('Admin / Rajesh V. Super Admin').
- Page Header:
  - Title: 'System Settings'
  - Subtitle: 'Manage organization identity, branding tokens, Razorpay gateway credentials, dynamic video watermarking, and security policies.'
  - Header actions: 'Export Settings JSON', 'View Audit Logs', with a status indicator 'Last saved 12 mins ago by Rajesh V.'

2. Internal Settings Navigation (Sub-navigation layout):
- Left secondary tab navigation column (width ~240px) or horizontal sticky sub-tabs:
  - General (Active with indigo pill/border indicator and icon)
  - Branding & White-label
  - Payments & Tax (Razorpay / Stripe)
  - Email & Notifications
  - Video Security & DRM
  - Domain & SEO
  - API & Webhooks
  - Advanced & Maintenance

3. Content Area - Form Sections in Clean Card Layouts (White rounded-xl cards with subtle border border-slate-200 and soft shadows):

Card 1: Institute Profile & Organization Info
- Section title: 'Institute Profile' with subtitle 'Legal identity and contact points displayed on invoices, student portal, and accredited certificates.'
- Grid layout:
  - Institute Name input: 'BICE Data Academy Pvt. Ltd.'
  - Support Email input: 'support@bice-academy.com' (verified badge)
  - Official Phone input: '+91 (800) 555-0199'
  - Registered Address textarea: 'Tech Plaza 400, Financial District, New York, NY 10004' & 'CIN: U80903KA2021PTC149204 | GSTIN: 27AABCB1234F1Z5'
  - Logo & Asset upload: Drag-and-drop zone with current square logo preview (dark blue icon with BICE symbol), 'Replace Logo (PNG, SVG max 2MB)', recommendation '512x512px'.

Card 2: Branding & Design Tokens
- Section title: 'Branding & Theme Tokens' with subtitle 'Controls global interface accent colors, email header badges, and web app assets.'
- Fields:
  - Primary Color swatch picker: Color input displaying '#4F46E5' (Indigo-600) with quick preset swatches (Corporate Indigo #4F46E5, Ocean Blue #2563EB, Emerald #059669, Slate #0F172A).
  - Favicon Upload box: 32x32px favicon preview with 'Replace Favicon (.ico, .png)'.
  - Dark Mode Admin Default toggle (Checked) and Student Portal Theme Mode ('User Controlled' select dropdown).

Card 3: Payments & Gateway Configuration (Razorpay Integration)
- Section title: 'Payments & Invoicing (Razorpay)' with subtitle 'Configure transactional gateway credentials, GST tax invoice generation, and student currency.'
- Status banner: Green success pill '● Connected & Healthy - Live Webhook Active' with 'Last verified ping: 2 mins ago'.
- Form fields:
  - Key ID: Masked input `rzp_live_8F************92` with eye toggle icon and copy button.
  - Webhook Secret: Masked input `whsec_98****************************1a` with eye toggle.
  - Settlement / Default Currency: Select dropdown displaying 'INR (₹ - Indian Rupee)' with USD and EUR options.
  - Tax / GST Percentage: Number input '18.0%' with helper text 'Applicable as 9% CGST + 9% SGST for intra-state or 18% IGST'.
  - 'Test Connection' secondary button + 'Manage Webhooks' link.

Card 4: Video Security & DRM Anti-Piracy
- Section title: 'Video Security & Forensic Watermarking' with subtitle 'Enforce enterprise DRM, concurrent stream restrictions, and dynamic viewer ID stamping to prevent unauthorized screen captures.'
- Controls:
  - Concurrent Stream Limit: Stepper input set to '2 concurrent devices per student ID'.
  - Forensic Watermark Opacity: Slider set to '12%' with preview text showing 'rahul.sharma@example.com [ID: 10234] | Oct 31, 2024'.
  - Playback Token Expiry: Dropdown set to '30 minutes' (options: 15 mins, 30 mins, 1 hour, 4 hours).
  - 'Allow Video Downloads' Toggle: Switched OFF (Grayed/Disabled) with warning callout pill: '⚠️ Offline caching restricted to mobile app only under signed Widevine L1 policy.'

Card 5: Rate Limiting & Enterprise Security
- Section title: 'Session & API Rate Limiting'
- Fields:
  - API Rate Limit (requests/min): '120 req/min per IP'
  - Maximum failed login attempts: '5 attempts before 15m lockout'
  - SSO & Two-Factor Authentication: Toggle switch ON with 'Enterprise Google Workspace SSO enforced'.
  - Link: 'Inspect Full Security Audit Logs →'

4. Sticky Bottom Save Bar:
- Fixed at the bottom of the content container (or floating sticky footer):
- Text: 'You have unsaved changes in Institute Profile and Video Security' with small yellow indicator dot.
- Right buttons: 'Discard Changes' (secondary outline button) and 'Save Changes' (solid indigo-600 button with checkmark icon).
